mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances that may potentiate beta-blocker effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; both drugs can impair renal function.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, and electrolytes before and after zoledronic acid infusion; assess cardiac rhythm and blood pressure; ensure adequate hydration; monitor renal function in patients receiving both agents.
